business.headline: Why is the Sensex up nearly 700 points today? Here's what's lifting marketsThe Sensex rose nearly 700 points and the Nifty climbed above 24,250 on Thursday. The rebound followed softer global cues, lower US bond yields and renewed buying in banking and IT shares.

Why govt wants Indian homes to switch from LPG cylinders to piped gasThe government has now introduced an incentive for city gas distributors to encourage more households to take up and actively use PNG connections.

Aditya Birla Capital enters gold loan business, shares jump 3%Aditya Birla Capital plans to open 200-300 dedicated gold loan branches by March 2027 across markets it considers to have strong potential.
Govt tightens sugar stock limits ahead of festive seasonThe new stock limit will cover confectionery makers, soft drink manufacturers, food processing companies and sweet sellers.

Can Rs 3 crore fund a lifetime? Here's the math behind a viral Reddit postA viral Reddit post has revived the question of whether Rs 3 crore can fund retirement for life. The answer turns on inflation, investment returns, expenses and how withdrawals change over time.

NBCC scraps e-auction of 262 premium residential units in Delhi's ChanakyapuriNBCC has cancelled the e-auction of freehold residential units at Avenue Towers on Africa Avenue. The company has offered full refunds, including the processing fee, while giving no fresh auction date.

Adani Enterprises makes a strong comeback, emerges as Nifty 50's top gainerAdani Enterprises has re-emerged as one of the Nifty50's strongest performers as large investors and lenders raise exposure to the group. The rebound follows years of scrutiny and sell-offs, though refinancing, regulation and foreign ownership remain under watch.

Gold nears Rs 1.60 lakh, silver crosses Rs 2.4 lakh: What should investors do now?Gold is knocking on the door of Rs 1.60 lakh, while silver has comfortably crossed Rs 2.4 lakh. As precious metals extend their gains, investors are weighing their next move.

From Covid vaccine to cancer breakthrough, Moderna's 177% surge explainedModerna's shares soared during the Covid vaccine boom before crashing as demand faded. A cancer breakthrough has now triggered the company's biggest-ever one-day gain, with the stock jumping 177%. Now, investors are asking whether cancer could give Moderna the next big growth story it has been searching for.

Sensex jumps over 550 points at open, Nifty above 24,200 as IT stocks leadThe BSE Sensex rose 554.88 points, or 0.72%, to 77,464.56 at around 9:36 am. The Nifty 50 gained 127.30 points, or 0.53%, to 24,205.60, after touching an early high of 24,225.45.

Moderna shares skyrocket 177% after cancer vaccine breakthroughModerna and Merck said their experimental mRNA cancer treatment met goals in a late-stage melanoma trial. The result reduced the risk of recurrence or spread versus Keytruda alone and lifted Moderna shares sharply.

HUL takes Beco to Delhi HC over harmful chemicals claims against Surf Excel, VimHUL has approached the Delhi High Court against Beco's campaign targeting Surf Excel and Vim. The court has sought Beco's reply and will hear both sides before deciding interim relief.

India replaces Indonesia as Asia's least-preferred stock marketA Bank of America (BofA) survey found India has replaced Indonesia as Asia's least-preferred stock market. The result underlines investor unease over valuations, growth and limited AI exposure despite better earnings.

Can money really buy happiness? A report puts a number to itA latest report estimates India's income satiation level at about Rs 20 lakh a year. The finding suggests extra earnings matter less to life evaluation after that point.

Your SBI FDs may earn less after latest rate cut: Check new ratesSBI has cut interest rates by 25 basis points (bps) on domestic bulk term deposits of Rs 3 crore and above for select tenures. The revised rates came into effect on August 15, 2026, according to the bank's website.

IndiGo website hit by glitch, passengers unable to book ticketsPassengers trying to book IndiGo flights online reported technical problems with flight availability on the airline's website. In some cases, users saw a 'No Data Available' message, signalling a disruption in the booking process.
Sensex, Nifty slide as crude hits 3-week high, bond yields riseThe Nifty 50 fell 76.60 points, or 0.32%, to close at 24,078.30, while the BSE Sensex declined 325.78 points, or 0.42%, to 76,909.68.

Zepto's free delivery minimum rises to Rs 199, at par with Blinkit, SwiggyZepto has hiked its free-delivery minimum order value to Rs 199 from Rs 149 in select areas, joining rivals Blinkit and Swiggy Instamart as quick-commerce companies seek to improve profitability.

From $1.5 million to $76.8 million: India's chip startups see funding surgeThe numbers reveal how India's chip sector is maturing. Bigger cheques mean investors are more confident in the ability of these startups to deliver results.

Tata Sons just missed its AGM for the first time. Why is this a big deal?Tata Sons adjourned its 108th AGM after failing to meet the quorum requirement. The disruption shows how a dispute within Tata Trusts has reached the group's holding company.

entertainment.headline: Ranbir Kapoor to start Brahmastra 2 in April. Will Deepika Padukone join? Filmmaker Ayan Mukerji is in talks with actor Deepika Padukone for Brahmastra 2. Reportedly, the actor will play the role of Amruta alongside Ranbir Kapoor's Shiva and Alia Bhatt's Isha.

Ramayan Katha star Anjali Arora visits Kainchi Dham amid backlash for playing Sita Anjali Arora visited Kainchi Dham and shared pictures after seeking Neem Karoli Baba's blessings. The post comes as her casting as Goddess Sita in Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha remains under online scrutiny.

When did Govinda-Ssunita's 39-year marriage become a public spectacle? A timeline Actor Govinda and Ssunita Ahuja's 39-year marriage has increasingly become a talking point, with old relationship rumours, public allegations and their recent back-and-forth bringing their private life into the spotlight.

Netflix sued by metal band Demon Hunter over KPop Demon Hunters title American metal band Demon Hunter has sued Netflix, Netflix Studios and AEG Presents over KPop Demon Hunters. The case centres on alleged consumer confusion as the franchise expands into music, merchandise and live shows.
Shweta Tiwari tags Tukaram Mundhe after cockroach found in online delivery Actor Shweta Tiwari tagged Maharashtra FDA Commissioner Tukaram Mundhe after she found a cockroach in her online order.

Toxic English trailer is 11 seconds shorter than Indian version. What has changed? Yash's Toxic has unveiled separate English and Indian trailers with small but noticeable changes. The differences sharpen attention on the film's global rollout and its father-son conflict.

Prime Video accidentally releases Jason Statham's Mutiny in US, fans shocked Amazon Prime Video briefly showed Jason Statham's Mutiny in full on its US platform before the film's exclusive cinema release. The apparent leak has raised fresh questions about high-profile movie security on major tech platforms.

Why Operation Safed Sagar ends every episode with a Raju Srivastav tribute Every episode of Operation Safed Sagar ends with a thank-you note to Raju Srivastav. The tribute reflects his role in backing Kushal Srivastava and the family's journey with the series.

No one can buy me: Rajpal Yadav says money can't define his 26-year journey Rajpal Yadav said his financial and legal troubles do not define him as an artist. He said his bond with cinema and theatre remains unchanged despite the dispute.

Kacha Badam girl Anjali Arora plays Sita in Ramayan Katha, internet not impressed Content creator Anjali Arora's casting as Goddess Sita in Mahakavya Shri Ramayan Katha has stirred online debate, drawing mixed reactions from social media users. While some question the choice and visual effects, others compare the film to Adipurush, highlighting the strong sentiments around this retelling of the epic Ramayana.

January 12 Vidudala: Venkatesh's film puts its release date right in the title Anil Ravipudi has unveiled January 12 Vidudala as the title of his Venkatesh and Kalyan Ram film. The playful announcement fixes the film in the Sankranthi 2027 race and hints at a brothers-in-law dynamic.

Awarapan 2 box office Day 6: Emraan's biggest opener is now in Rs 150-crore club Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2 has crossed Rs 150 crore globally within six days despite a dip in daily collections. The film maintains a strong box office hold and is expected to surge past Rs 150-crore India nett milestone soon.

Why Ramayana's trolled VFX suddenly look good next to Avengers: Doomsday Online reaction to Avengers: Doomsday's new footage has unexpectedly shifted attention to Ramayana's visual effects. The reversal shows how quickly audience perception changes when Hollywood faces the same scrutiny as Indian cinema.

Batwara 1947 box office Day 6: Domestic earnings lose steam, films hits Rs 45 crore Batwara 1947 opened strong during the Independence Day holiday, collecting Rs 45.42 crore worldwide in six days but is now facing a sharp decline on weekdays. The Rajkumar Santoshi-directed film, starring Sunny Deol, is competing with Awarapan 2.

Viswanath and Sons box office Day 6: Just Rs 15 crore away from Rs 150-crore club Suriya and Mamitha Baiju's Vishwanath And Sons earned an estimated Rs 5.10 crore India nett on Day 6, taking its worldwide gross to Rs 135.49 crore. The collections dipped from Tuesday, but the film held steady across Tamil and Telugu markets.

Apoorva Makhija says she moved to New York to escape fame, online pressure Apoorva said she moved to New York for an MBA at NYU Stern while stepping back from the demands of being The Rebel Kid online. She said the shift will help her understand business better and prepare for building a D2C brand in India.

Prithviraj vs Nivin, action vs family drama: Who wins the Onam box office 2026? Prithviraj Sukumaran's Khalifa and Nivin Pauly's Bethlehem Kudumba Unit are heading for an Onam box-office clash. The contest matters as both stars seek momentum, while audiences get two sharply different festive options.

Mini Mathur says she lost Indian Idol 5 hosting job after revealing pregnancy Mini Mathur said she was dropped from Indian Idol Season 5 after telling the team she was pregnant with her second child. She said the decision left her feeling let down and later led her to decline a return for Season 6.

Haiwaan song Mere Hero Hai Woh brings out Saif Ali Khan's softer side The first song from Haiwaan, titled Mere Hero Hai Woh, featuring actor Saif Ali Khan, focusses on an emotional narrative. Saif plays a visually challenged character in the upcoming film directed by Priyadarshan.

general news.headline: Sajjan Kumar, ex-Congress MP convicted for anti-Sikh riots, dies at 80 in jailSajjan Kumar, who was serving a life sentence in Delhi's Tihar Jail in anti-Sikh riot-related cases, was declared brought dead at Safdarjung Hospital.

Did RAF fire non-existent plastic pellets at CJP protesters?Two cartridges with plastic pellets were fired at protesters by the Rapid Action Force (RAF) of the CRPF during the July 20 Parliament march in New Delhi, said a general dairy entry. But no expert has ever seen plastic pellets, heard of them being used, or encountered a victim injured by them. Here's what we got after a month-long chase of the mysterious pellets.

Telangana principal stabbed 27 times, one word leads cops to Class 10 killersTelangana police alleged that two minor former students killed school principal Roopa Reddy at her home in Nalgonda for cash. Investigators tracked them through CCTV footage, her final "Babu" clue and bloodstained currency notes recovered from one of the accused.

Not data, RAM is new oil and Sridhar Vembu rightly warns it is making life expensiveThere is a cliche often repeated in India: data is new oil. In 2026 we are learning just how wrong it is. It's not data that is the new scarce, and yet essential, commodity. Instead, it is RAM and, as Zoho boss Sridhar Vembu has noted, it is doing to the world what oil has done for years.

Secret deal behind Imran Khan's hospital transfer? Pak journalist's big theoryThe Pakistan Supreme Court's order to shift jailed Imran Khan to a private hospital after three years has sparked unease within the Shehbaz Sharif-led government. Senior Pakistani journalist Hamid Mir explains why.

India outpaces China in GDP growth rate. Why it's a success but not a victoryA comparison of decadal GDP data since the 1980s shows that India has crossed China in growth rate since 2020. For half of the current decade, India has accelerated while China has slowed. While this is a success, it is not an outright victory. Here's the full story.

Congress insulting freedom fighters: Amit Shah attacks party's Vande Mataram standAmit Shah accused Congress of "appeasement politics" over its refusal to follow the protocol for singing the full Vande Mataram at government functions. He alleged the 1937 decision to split the song contributed to Partition and said Congress had insulted Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay and freedom fighters.

Moderna cancer vaccine steps closer to clinic use after late-stage trial milestoneModerna and Merck said their personalised mRNA cancer vaccine cut melanoma recurrence and spread in a late-stage trial. The result marks a significant step for mRNA-based cancer treatment and sparked a sharp market reaction.

YouTuber gets friend to pose as a beggar in Haridwar. Here's how much he earnedA YouTuber made his friend pose as a beggar at Haridwar's Kawad Mela and ask for money from devotees. Their day's earnings have left social media users stunned.

Only Indians, Americans allowed: Pak MP claims UAE hotel snub after cancelled flightPakistani travellers were denied hotel accommodation after a UAE flight cancellation while Indian and US passport holders were accommodated, a Pak MP alleged in the National Assembly.

Tit-for-tat bulldozer action outside Pak High Commission in Delhi, barricades razedAuthorities demolished structures and barricades outside the Pakistan High Commission in Delhi after finding them beyond the approved boundary. The tit-for-tat move came days after Pakistan removed security barriers outside the Indian High Commission in Islamabad.

Is Donald Trump looking at India's SIR to SAVE US polls?US President Donald Trump cited Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and India's election system to back the SAVE America Act bill. It seeks to require proof of citizenship for voter registration, photo ID to vote, and tighter rules for mail-in ballots in federal elections. How is that similar to, and different from, the nationwide SIR by the Gyanesh Kumar-led ECI?

While some question the choice and visual effects, others compare the film to Adipurush, highlighting the strong sentiments around this retelling of the epic Ramayana.

Bengaluru student spends 3 months as Rapido rider, shares earnings and learningsA college student's three-month stint as a Rapido rider in Bengaluru during his vacation gave him more than just extra money. In a viral Reddit post, he detailed his daily earnings, long hours, delivery hassles and more.

IIT Madras builds engineers. Now it plans MBBS and MD degrees too, says KamakotiIIT Madras Director Professor V. Kamakoti says the institute will open a school of medical sciences and award its own medical degrees. Here is what the plan means, and the regulatory road it must travel to actually produce doctors.

No need to rush: Bangladesh says PM Tarique Rahman's India visit chances slimBangladesh PM's aide said Dhaka expects New Delhi to address its concerns and ensure an environment of mutual trust before any high-level visit can take place.

Private Ganga aarti and then a spa: What luxury moksha looks likeFrom Char Dham helicopter journeys to private Ganga Aarti and exclusive puja experiences, spirituality and pilgrimage now come soaked in luxury.

Why this melanoma vaccine is used after cancer treatmentMerck and Moderna have reported encouraging Phase 3 results for a personalised mRNA cancer vaccine in melanoma when used with pembrolizumab. The treatment aims to stop recurrence after surgery, though peer-reviewed data and longer follow-up are still awaited.

Tehelka founder Tarun Tejpal goes to Supreme Court against rape case convictionGoa government had challenged the 10-year sentence for Tejpal, seeking life imprisonment and arguing that the punishment does not adequately reflect the gravity of the offences.

Did BJP make a U-turn? Congress raises a caste alarm in Census 2027The Congress has launched an attack on the BJP-led central government, alleging it was trying to undercount the number of the OBC population. It is trying to corner the NDA government through the latter's argument on the validity of the 2011 caste census. SC and OBC groups have raised concerns too.

Mumbai model who stopped police van seeks FIR withdrawal, action against threatsModel Riya Ahir has sought strict action against those threatening her online. The Mumbai police assured a delegation that the matter will be addressed.

Manav Suthar reminds India what classical spin looks likeManav Suthar's 10-wicket haul in Galle showcased the qualities of classical Test spin, with the young left-armer using drift, overspin, bounce, pace and subtle variations to dismantle Sri Lanka.

Rats in kitchen, toaster atop dustbin: FDA suspends Mumbai restaurant licenceMumbai's Hotel Radha in Malad West had its food licence suspended after an FDA inspection found rats, cockroaches, open drains, stagnant water, dirty utensils and other serious hygiene violations.
Tourists walk into Dehradun's Robber's Cave with boom box, dance to Haryanvi songsA video showed a group of men dancing through Dehradun's Robber's Cave with a boom box playing a Haryanvi song.

sports.headline: Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly shock 7th seeds, one win away from medal BWF World Championships: India's Gayatri Gopichand and Treesa Jolly shocked the 7th seed Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi in their Round of 16 clash on Thursday, August 20. They are now one win away from a medal at the World Championships.

Hockey World Cup: Can Indian women create history and top Pool D? India's women face England with a first-ever Pool D finish within reach. The match could decide whether India can win the group or exit from the competition altogether.

Badminton World Championships: India stars set for tricky games in Round of 16 BWF World Championships: India are set for some really tricky games in the Badminton World Championships on August 20. Ayush Shetty, PV Sindhu face their toughest opponents yet, while Satwiksairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty play their first game.

Manav Suthar reminds India what classical spin looks like Manav Suthar's 10-wicket haul in Galle showcased the qualities of classical Test spin, with the young left-armer using drift, overspin, bounce, pace and subtle variations to dismantle Sri Lanka.

Ollie Robinson and Josh Tongue split match-ball after Pakistan rout Ollie Robinson and Josh Tongue split the match ball after sharing five-wicket hauls against Pakistan at Headingley. The gesture capped England's rout of Pakistan for 171 and highlighted Robinson's strong comeback.

Lionel Messi scores first goal since father's death with touching tribute Lionel Messi returned to the scoresheet with a goal and an assist for Inter Miami against Philadelphia Union. The Argentine captain's first goal since his father's death came with a subdued celebration as Miami drew 2-2.

India escape pool stages at Hockey World Cup, but old habits still remain India beat Pakistan 5-3 to reach the second round of the men's Hockey World Cup 2026. The win settled qualification, but defensive lapses, thin attacking depth and disciplinary issues exposed familiar faults.

18-year-old came to BWF Worlds with a Friday return ticket. Then he beat Lakshya Garret Tan arrived in Delhi as an 18-year-old American ranked 92nd in the world, with little more than a first World Championships experience in mind. He left Lakshya Sen stunned, his return ticket and plans back home suddenly up in the air.

Josh Tongue explains England's 'brave' approach behind Pakistan collapse Josh Tongue said England's bowlers had to be brave with their lengths after Pakistan were dismissed for 171 at Headingley. His five-wicket haul, alongside Ollie Robinson's return spell, left England 112/2 and firmly in control.

Ederson still puzzled by failed Manchester United move Ederson remains puzzled by Manchester United's decision to abandon his summer transfer despite insisting his medical went well. The Brazilian midfielder has since renewed his Atalanta contract after turning down other options while expecting a move to Old Trafford.

AIFF defends Brazil clash, rubbishes claims of ASEAN Cup penalty claims The AIFF has stood by its decision to prioritise India's Brazil friendly, while rejecting claims of a predetermined financial penalty for withdrawing from the ASEAN Cup and questioning unverified figures surrounding its finances.

ISL to start in October with 13 teams after Diamond Harbour miss deadlineThe Indian Super League (ISL) is set to begin in October with 13 teams after Diamond Harbour FC failed to meet the deadline to submit the required documents for the upcoming season. The club's absence means the league will proceed with a reduced number of teams.

Sri Lanka vs India: Kusal Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal to miss Colombo TestSri Lanka head coach Gary Kirsten confirmed that the hosts will be without Kusal Mendis and Dinesh Chandimal for the second Test against India in Colombo. Top-order batter Pathum Nissanka is also a doubt, leaving Sri Lanka short of three first-choice batters for a must-win Test.

Lakshya Sen was very ordinary, no excuse for his loss to Garret Tan: CoachGarret Tan produced the biggest win of his young career, stunning Lakshya Sen in three games at the Delhi World Championships on Wednesday. But coach Vimal Kumar felt the Indian was passive, error-prone and far below his best.

SL vs IND: Saransh Jain likely to make India debut in Colombo TestSaransh Jain is on the verge of making his India debut in the second Test against Sri Lanka in Colombo, with the Madhya Pradesh all-rounder emerging as a strong contender for a place in the playing XI.

BCCI shifts Duleep Trophy final from Bengaluru to Chennai to allow spectatorsThe BCCI has shifted the Duleep Trophy 2026-27 final from the Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bengaluru to the MA Chidambaram Stadium in Chennai, allowing spectators to attend the marquee domestic fixture.

Gianni Infantino loses more support as FIFA official calls COO firing 'final straw'More national football federations and FIFA officials have withdrawn their support for president Gianni Infantino following the departure of COO Kevin Lamour, which one FIFA vice-president called the "final straw".

India edge Pakistan in Amstelveen thriller, reach Hockey World Cup 2nd roundIndia held off Pakistan's late charge to win a nerve-shredding match in Amstelveen. The result sent India into the World Cup second round and extended their long unbeaten run against their arch-rivals and eliminated them from medal contention.

Lakshya falls to World No. 92, Ayush and Sindhu march into pre-quartersBWF World Championships: Lakshya Sen suffered a shock second-round exit to World No. 92 Garret Tan, while Ayush Shetty and PV Sindhu marched into the pre-quarters on Wednesday. Satwik-Chirag advanced without hitting a shuttle after receiving a walkover.

Gary Kirsten breaks silence on Galle reunion with old pal Gautam GambhirGary Kirsten and Gautam Gambhir shared a long conversation on the sidelines of the Galle Test, but the meeting between the former India coach and his one-time player was not about their memories from the 2011 World Cup triumph.

KL Rahul wants India to build on confidence after passing Sri Lanka spin testKL Rahul said India's 165-run win over Sri Lanka reflected the progress they have made against spin, with the victory boosting the team's confidence ahead of the Colombo Test and next year's home series against Australia.

Hockey World Cup Highlights: India eliminate Pakistan to move into second roundInd Vs Pak Hockey World Cup 2026 Highlights: Braces from Harmanpreet Singh, Abhishek and a goal from Hardik Singh were enough for India to fend off a spirited performance from Pakistan to make it to the second round.

Don't drop Kuldeep: Pundits tell Gill, Gambhir to stick with spinner for ColomboVenkatesh Prasad and Cheteshwar Pujara have urged India to retain Kuldeep Yadav for the Colombo Test despite his muted Galle outing. Kuldeep picked up just one wicket across both innings in the first Test.

India's WTC push gathers pace after Galle Test win: What they need to do nowIndia beat Sri Lanka by 165 runs in the first Test in Galle to take a 1-0 lead in the series. The win earned India 12 crucial WTC points and revived their hopes of reaching the final after they finished third in the previous cycle.

Manav Suthar urged to preserve his strengths for Test cricket over IPL's richesManav Suthar's stunning start to Test cricket has prompted Cheteshwar Pujara to urge the young spinner to preserve his natural strengths in red-ball cricket and not alter his game for the riches and demands of the IPL.

Nick Kyrgios suspended from tennis after testing positive for cocaineNick Kyrgios has been provisionally suspended after testing positive for cocaine during the Mallorca Open. The case leaves him barred from the sport for now and adds to the uncertainty around his comeback.

BWF Worlds Highlights: Sindhu and Ayush into pre-quarters, Lakshya knocked outBadminton World Championships Highlights, August 19: A winning finish to the day! PV Sindhu beat Canada's Wen Yu Zhang 21-16, 21-17 in 35 minutes to storm into the pre-quarterfinals. Ayush Shetty also marched into the last 16 with a dominant 21-8, 21-10 win over Sri Lanka's Dumindu Abeywickrama. After heartbreak for Lakshya Sen and Unnati Hooda, Sindhu and Ayush give India something to smile about.

India conquer spin demon, renew WTC Final charge in GalleIndia overcame a stubborn Sri Lankan resistance on the final day to seal a 165-run win in the Galle Test. Manav Suthar picked up 6 wickets for 55 runs and guided India to a victory in the opening Test of the series.

Yashavsi Jaiswal rage baits Dickwella into throwing away his wicketYashasvi Jaiswal got under Niroshan Dickwella's skin with some cheeky banter during Sri Lanka's fourth-innings chase in the Galle Test. Dickwella appeared to take the bait, only to fall for 10 runs in the very next over.

Jamal Musiala reveals neurological issue after on-field collapse in pre-seasonJamal Musiala revealed he had been diagnosed with temporary, easily treatable absence seizures after collapsing during Bayern Munich's preseason friendly against Heidenheim, three days after a similar incident against RB Leipzig.

education.headline: The role of data analytics in modern advertising educationThis transformation also exercises a significant impact on the realm of 'advertising education.'

NCERT deletes Azad Pak, adds China's aggression reference in Class 12 textbookThe NCERT has made final changes to its Class 12 Political Science textbook syllabus for the upcoming academic year, including a revision in reference to India's border situation with China, Azad Pakistan, Article 370 and more.

NEET row: Bihar cops find 6 post-dated cheques 'issued for question paper brokers'Six post-dated cheques which were suspected to have been issued in favour of mafia demanding over Rs 30 lakh from each candidate seeking alleged leaked question paper ahead of NEET held last month were recovered by Bihar Police.

Forest fires surge tenfold from 2004 to 2017: Causes, impact and preventionAmidst a relentless surge, intense forest fires are now multiplying tenfold, casting a menacing shadow over our flora and fauna. Year by year, their fiery grip tightens, threatening ecosystems far and wide, now extending their reach to impact human lives.

Fresh plea in Supreme Court to recall NEET results, reconduct examsA fresh petition has been filed in the Supreme Court to recall the National Entrance cum Eligibility Test - Under Graduate (NEET-UG) 2024 results and re-conduct fresh examination after discrepancies in the declared results.

NTA issues clarification after NEET result controversy over toppers, high cut-offIn a detailed statement, the National Testing Agency (NTA) said that the increase in cut-off and number of toppers in the NEET-UG reflect the competitive nature of the exam and maintained that the test's integrity has not been compromised.

Exclusive: Arvind Kejriwal claims 'BJP succession war, PM backing Amit Shah'Speaking exclusively to India Today TV, Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal claimed that there is a "succession war" within the BJP. He also claimed that the ruling party is "not fighting the Lok Sabha elections as a team".

4 medical students arrested in Bihar for appearing as proxies for NEET aspirantsFour MBBS students who appeared in place of NEET aspirants in the medical entrance exam were detained in Bihar's Purnea.

NEET-UG question paper not leaked, claims baseless: National Testing AgencyThe reports claiming question paper leak in the medical entrance exam NEET-UG are "completely baseless and without any ground", the National Testing Agency (NTA) has clarified.
The generation with answers: Tech-savvy Indian youth tackling global challengesIndia's tech-savvy youth rewriting the global narrative, one solution at a time.

Left sweeps JNU students' polls, Dhananjay is first Dalit presidentThe Left swept the Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls, winning all four posts and trouncing the RSS-affiliated ABVP. The ABVP was leading at one point, but the Left eventually surged ahead and emerged victorious.
The power of knowledge: Education's influence on real estate market trendsIn a dynamic sector like real estate, investing in continuing education is not simply an option; it is a requirement.

JNU students' body election on March 22 after 4 yearsThe Jawaharlal Nehru University Students' Union (JNUSU) polls will take place on March 22, more than four years after the last elections were held in September 2019.

UP 12th board exam math, biology papers leaked on WhatsApp, complaint filedThe mathematics and biology question papers for the Uttar Pradesh class 12 board exam were allegedly leaked on a WhatsApp group.

UP Police Constable recruitment exam cancelled days after paper leakThe Uttar Pradesh Police Constable recruitment exam held on February 17 and 18 was canceled due to a paper leak. The Chief Minister has announced a re-examination within the next six months.
